entities.name: PMID:25097850
observations: 2014 Asia Pacific Allergy study of induced-sputum eosinophil reference ranges in Korean healthy nonasthmatic adults.
Among 208 recruited adults, 81 (38.9%) produced adequate analyzable samples; the upper 90th percentile was 3.5%.
Atopic participants had median 1.6% (range 0–11.0%); non-atopic participants had median 0% (range 0–3.6%).

The study provides a provisional population upper reference estimate, but the selected sample and available excerpts do not establish a robust laboratory interval or confirm a strictly nonsquamous-cell denominator.

entities.name: Korean sputum eosinophil limit
observations: In Korean healthy nonasthmatic adults, the induced-sputum eosinophil upper 90th percentile was 3.5%; the observed minimum was 0%.
This is a population reference estimate rather than a fully validated laboratory reference interval.

entities.name: Asthma sputum cutoff
observations: Korean asthma cohorts used >3% induced-sputum eosinophils to define eosinophilic asthma; this is a disease-phenotyping threshold, not a healthy reference interval.
Korean T2-high phenotyping also used ≥2% as a clinical biomarker threshold.
